title: hieracium breviflorum
intro: Hieracium breviflorum, commonly known as Dwarf Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the dandelion family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium breviflorum include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as its antimicrobial and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium breviflorum may include the treatment of various conditions, including wounds, infections, and inflammatory diseases.
